d: Eradah Group is seeking an experienced Operations Manager to lead and oversee its coffee, and desserts operations in Riyadh.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing multi-branch operations, improving operational efficiency, maintaining product quality, developing teams, controlling costs, and driving business growth and profitability.
q: Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in coffee shops, and desserts operations.
Strong knowledge of specialty coffee, beverages, desserts, and F&B operations.
Solid understanding of operational budgeting, cost control, sales analysis, and profitability.
Experience developing operational plans and performance KPIs.
Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
Proficiency in POS systems and operational reporting tools.
Must be based in Riyadh or willing to relocate.
